title: Validated, Immutable Database Configuration Builder
instructions: In `dbconfig.py`, implement `DatabaseConfiguration.builder()` and `DatabaseConfigurationBuilder`. The builder has fluent setters (`with_allowed_host` appends), defaults, and a `build()` that validates everything and raises one `ValueError` listing all problems. Every `build()` returns a new frozen object that later builder changes cannot affect.

evidence.label: A valid build applies the defaults (10 connections, no cache, not read-only, no hosts)
Fluent setters chain, and with_allowed_host appends into a tuple
build() reports every problem in one ValueError joined by '; '
Only postgresql:// and mysql:// URLs are accepted
Missing username or password is rejected
Each build() returns a new, equal object
Later builder changes do not leak into earlier products
The product is frozen and the password is hidden from repr
